response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.healtheval AS status, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.site_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_avg AS above_mean FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg ORDER BY above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Scan count is the number of scans in the group within the date range, including scans whose ratio is missing. The average skips those scans.
A spanmin of 0 is treated as a missing ratio (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero.
The date bounds are inclusive. chronotag is compared as text, as the request says.
The mean of all group averages is an unweighted mean over groups that have a non-null average. Groups with a null healtheval still form their own group.
